career_path_block.说明: A strong place to build flight hours

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risks for pilots are thresholds and cycles, not AI. AI cannot take your cockpit, but medical certification, licenses, and market swings can change your career path at any time.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks are professional and physical thresholds, not AI. Training is expensive, self-funded flight school can cost hundreds of thousands, licenses take a long time to earn, and strict medical standards become harder with age. Economic cycles and major events can also cause groundings and layoffs.
risks: High training cost: large investment over a long period
Physical threshold: strict medical standards become harder with age
Industry volatility: economic and event shocks can cause groundings and layoffs
Responsibility pressure: lifelong accountability for safety
Lifestyle: rotating shifts and time-zone crossings affect families

page.contract_project_risk_block: Autopilot can fly an aircraft, but only a pilot in the seat can answer who carries responsibility for the safety of hundreds of people in the cabin.

responsibilities: Execute flight missions and ensure safety
skills: Aircraft control and takeoff and landing techniques

career_risk_cards.callout: 飞行员最大的风险不是 AI，而是「门槛与周期」——AI 抢不走你的驾驶舱，但体检、执照和市场波动，随时可能改写你的职业轨迹。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「职业门槛与身体门槛」：培养成本高（自费学飞动辄几十万）、执照获取周期长，体检标准严格且随年龄下降；行业还受经济周期和突发事件冲击，停飞与裁员风险真实存在。
risks: 培养成本高：学飞投入大周期长
身体门槛：体检严格且随年龄下降
行业波动：经济与事件冲击停飞裁员
责任压力：安全责任终身背负
生活方式：倒班跨时区家庭付出

page.contract_project_risk_block: 自动驾驶能让飞机自动飞，但「舱里几百人的安全由谁负责」——这道题，只有坐在驾驶位上的飞行员敢答。

responsibilities: 执行飞行任务并确保安全

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone, but heavy responsibility + narrow skills. Workers who only scan slides without adding interpretation and quality control face displacement.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest job risk is not AI alone, but heavy responsibility + slow cycles. A culture error forces a complete repeat, while automated karyotype scanning absorbs some initial screening. People who advance into complex-abnormality interpretation + quality control are more resilient; scan-only roles face displacement.
risks: High culture responsibility
Automated scanning absorbs slide review
Slow, repetitive cycles
Long periods of seated review
Certification and training costs

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable AI becomes at scanning slides, technologists still decide which slide needs repeating and which translocation is present. Genetic interpretation cannot remove the human role entirely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任重 + 技能单一」——不补判读与质控，只扫片会被 AI 吃。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「责任重 + 周期慢」——培养出错全盘重来，且自动核型扫描在吃部分初筛。向「复杂异常判读 + 质控」升级的人更稳，纯扫片型易被替。
risks: 培养责任重
自动扫描吃扫片
周期慢重复
需长期坐检
证书与培训成本

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管 AI 多会扫片，那片该不该重做、哪条易位，最后还是技术员的眼去数、脑去判、手去复核——遗传判读这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Multidisciplinary role with a high ceiling

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is AI itself. Classification, extraction, and filing can be automated, compressing document roles that remain at the execution layer. Advancement into governance and compliance is necessary.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is direct AI replacement. AI tools increasingly handle document classification, metadata generation, and content extraction, reducing execution-only roles. Professionals who do not advance into workflow design, compliance governance, and business collaboration face growing pressure.
risks: AI replacement: execution tasks such as classification and filing become automated
Job contraction: fewer execution-only document-control roles
Marginalized value: limited recognition from business departments
Compliance accountability: document teams bear responsibility when controls fail
Income ceiling: execution roles have limited earning potential

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can classify every document, but Document Management Specialists still answer the fundamental operating questions: what cannot be deleted, who can access it, and how the rules are enforced.

responsibilities: Manage document systems and archive digitization
Set retention, destruction, and compliance policies
Train and assist departments in compliant use

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险就是 AI 本身——分类、提取、归档都能自动化，停在执行层的文档管理岗会最先被压缩，必须向治理与合规升级。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险就是「AI 替代」——文档分类、元数据生成、内容提取这些传统核心工作正被 AI 工具大量接管，纯执行型文档管理岗位在收缩；不向流程设计、合规治理和业务协同升级的从业者，处境会越来越难。
risks: AI 替代：分类归档等执行环节被接管
岗位收缩：纯执行型文控岗减少
价值边缘化：不被业务部门重视
合规担责：出问题时文档管理背锅
收入上限：执行岗收入天花板低

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能自动分好每一份文档，但「哪些不能删、谁能看、怎么守规矩」——这些企业运行的根本问题，还得靠文档管理专家来回答。

responsibilities: 设计文档分类与权限体系
管理文档系统与档案数字化
制定保留销毁与合规策略
培训并支持各部门规范使用
skills: 分类体系与元数据设计

career_path_block.说明: Most affected by smart diagnostics and integration

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but falling behind technical change. AI diagnostics replace standard procedures, while technicians who cannot keep pace with connected and new-energy vehicle technology face the real displacement risk.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI but a gap in technical development. Vehicle electronics are moving rapidly from basic systems to smart cockpits and from traditional harnesses to centralized domain control. Technicians who rely on old knowledge face displacement. As connected systems become more integrated, repair shifts from parts replacement toward flashing, calibration, and software diagnostics, continuously raising the skill threshold.
risks: Technical change: relying on old knowledge quickly leads to displacement
Greater integration: software reduces hardware-only roles
Physical demands: prolonged crouching, bending, and electrical work
Income stratification: large gap between entry-level workers and technicians
Customer communication: explaining faults takes time and effort

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI diagnostic tools can read codes and suggest checks, but a fault that appears only during hard acceleration or a wire that loses contact at a specific temperature remains hidden in the data. Technicians must reproduce these conditions beside the vehicle and use hands-on judgment to find the cause.

responsibilities: Install and wire in-vehicle electronic equipment
Read and analyze trouble codes to locate problems
Repair or replace faulty modules and harnesses
Commission systems, perform updates, and run functional tests

career_path_block.说明: 最受智能诊断与集成化冲击

career_risk_cards.callout: 汽车电子维修工最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「技术迭代的断层」——AI 诊断替代的是标准流程，而跟不上智能网联和新能源技术的人，才是真正被行业淘汰的。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「技术迭代的断层」：汽车电子从功能机到智能座舱、从传统线束到整车域控，技术更新极快，吃老本的维修工会被淘汰；同时智能网联设备集成度越来越高，维修从「换件」转向「刷写、标定、软件诊断」，技能门槛持续抬高。
risks: 技术迭代：吃老本很快被淘汰
集成度提高：软件化挤压纯硬件岗
身体消耗：久蹲久弯腰、接触电气
收入分层：初级与技师差距大
客户沟通：故障解释费时费力

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 诊断仪能读出代码、给出建议，但「这车只有在急加速时才报这个故障、那根线在特定温度下才断触」——这种藏在数据背后的隐性问题和现场手感，只能由蹲在车边的技师一点点试出来。

responsibilities: 安装车载电子设备并布线
读取分析故障码定位问题
维修更换故障模块与线束
系统调试、升级与功能测试

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but systems absorbing appointment and clerical back-office work. People with strong companionship and on-site skills become more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: Occupational risk is low. The main pressure comes from process standardization and online appointments replacing some reception tasks, but support through grief, family coordination, and on-site control still depend entirely on people.
risks: Standardized reception work
Online appointments replace some tasks
Documentation automation
High emotional strain
Difficult hiring

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, people still decide when a farewell needs more time, how to guide the family through it, and how to steady the service. Human presence cannot be fully removed from end-of-life care.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「预约 + 文书」后台被系统吃，有陪伴力与现场力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险很低，主要是流程标准化与线上预约对前台的轻微替代；但面对 grief 的陪伴、家属协调与现场把控仍完全靠人。
risks: 前台标准化
线上预约替代
文书自动化
情绪消耗高
招人难

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪场告别要慢一点、怎么陪家属走完、现场怎么稳，最后还是承办人的脑去想、嘴去说、手去排——生命这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI itself but automated monitoring. Systems absorb data-copying tasks, while operators who inspect and respond to emergencies remain more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: Automation is the occupation's main risk. SCADA automates monitoring records and replaces some entry-level control-room work. Operators who inspect equipment, understand systems, and handle emergencies remain resilient, while safety responsibility stays extremely high.
risks: SCADA reduces control-room monitoring
Extremely high safety responsibility
Remote rotating shifts
High emergency-response pressure
Aging equipment

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, operators still decide how to inspect equipment, interpret unusual sounds, and respond to emergencies. Safe gas transport cannot remove human hearing, action, and judgment completely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「自动化监盘」——抄数被吃，能巡检能应急的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险是自动化——SCADA 把监测记录自动化，初级监盘被替；能巡检、能应急、懂设备的人仍稳，且安全责任极重。
risks: SCADA 吃监盘
安全责任极重
偏远轮班
应急压力大
设备老化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，怎么巡检、怎么听异响、应急怎么处置，最后还是操作员的耳去听、手去关、脑去判——气稳不稳，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risks are scarce positions and high-pressure evaluation, not AI. AI changes research methods but cannot change the reality of faculty competition.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is scarce academic positions, not AI. University openings attract far more candidates than available jobs, up-or-out pressure is high, and graduates often spend years in postdoctoral roles. Failure to publish strong papers can end the path; this is the occupation's real selection mechanism.
risks: Scarce faculty roles: too many candidates and up-or-out systems
Publication pressure: intense journal competition
Average income: humanities compensation is relatively low
Evaluation pressure: dual teaching and research assessment
Specialization anxiety: obscure fields have narrower exits

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can organize historical sources for teachers, but only the person at the lectern can answer why a historical question deserves study.

responsibilities: Teach history courses and design instruction
Guide student research and paper writing
Participate in disciplinary development and public service

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 检索直接压缩

career_risk_cards.callout: 高校历史教师最大的风险不是 AI，而是「岗位稀缺 + 考核高压」——AI 改变的是研究方式，改变不了教职竞争的现实。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「学术岗位的稀缺」——高校教职僧多粥少，非升即走压力大，博士毕业后先做几年博士后、发不出好论文就可能出局，这才是这行真正的淘汰机制。
risks: 教职稀缺：僧多粥少、非升即走
发表压力：期刊竞争激烈
收入一般：人文学科收入偏低
考核压力：教学科研双考核
方向焦虑：冷门方向出路更窄

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能替教师整理史料，但「为什么这段历史值得研究」这个问题，只有站在讲台上的人能回答。

responsibilities: 讲授历史课程并设计教学
指导学生研究与论文写作
参与学科建设与公共服务

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is the combination of administrative overload and heavy responsibility. The work is detailed, messages are constant, and accountability is substantial.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risk is the combination of administrative overload and heavy responsibility. Classroom setup, lesson planning, and family messages consume time, while safety accountability remains high. Content tools also reduce preparation work, placing pressure on purely scripted teaching.
risks: Lower birth rates and preschool consolidation
Family messages consume substantial time
Heavy safety responsibility
Content tools absorb lesson preparation
Few established positions and wide compensation differences

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable the tools become, teachers must still notice when a child is struggling, respond to emotions, and protect children during unexpected events. Human attention, physical care, and emotional steadiness remain essential to early childhood education.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「事务叠加 + 责任重」——活细、消息多、担责大。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「事务叠加 + 责任重」——环创、备课、家园群消息占满时间，且安全责任大；同时素材生成工具吃掉部分备课，纯照本宣科的老师被挤压。
risks: 出生率降，园所整合
家园群消息占满时间
安全责任重
素材工具吃备课
编内少，待遇分化

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多好，那孩子今天不在状态、情绪怎么接、突发怎么护，最后还是老师的眼去看、手去抱、心去稳——幼教这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Stable demand, supplemented by underground allowances
Responsible for both safety and production

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are underground safety and resource cycles, not AI. Safety always comes first, while market fluctuations directly determine whether shifts continue.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is underground work itself: ground collapse, water inflow, machinery injuries, dust, and noise. Safety always comes before production. Mining employment also fluctuates with resource-price cycles.
risks: Underground safety risks: collapse, water inflow, and machinery injuries
Resource-cycle volatility: mineral prices affect employment stability
Physical wear: dust, noise, vibration, and shift work
Autonomous transition: standardized operating roles contract
Credential and medical thresholds exclude people with unsuitable physical conditions

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can guide an LHD through a tunnel more precisely than a person, but people still judge whether to ease the bucket when a rock bolt is mixed into the ore and provide the hard-to-define alertness of underground work, from either the cab or control console.

responsibilities: Load and transfer underground ore and waste rock
Plan vehicle and loading routes from dispatch instructions
Perform pre-shift equipment inspection and basic maintenance
Follow safety procedures and hand off shift records

career_path_block.说明: 需求稳定，靠井下津贴加分

career_path_block.路径: 无人化设备监控/遥控员

career_risk_cards.callout: 地下采矿机械操作员最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「井下安全」与「资源周期」——安全永远是第一位的，行情起伏则直接决定这个班次能不能接续。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「井下作业本身的风险」：塌方、涌水、机械伤害、粉尘噪声，安全永远排在产量前面；同时矿山行业随资源价格周期波动，行情影响用工稳定。
risks: 井下安全风险：塌方、涌水、机械伤害
资源周期波动：矿价影响用工稳定性
身体损耗：粉尘、噪声、振动与倒班
无人化转型：标准化操作岗位压缩
取证与体检门槛：身体条件不符进不来

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能让铲运机在巷道里跑得比人还直，但「矿岩里混了根锚杆、铲斗该不该收力」这种判断，和井下那份说不清道不明的警觉，还得靠人坐在驾驶位或控制台前。

responsibilities: 铲装并转运井下矿石与废石
按调度指令规划行车与接矿路线
执行设备班前检查与简单维护
遵守安全规程并交接班次记录

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone, but algorithms combined with platforms. Systems absorb manual routing, while professionals with network-design skills become more resilient.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is not AI alone, but algorithmic optimization combined with platforms. Systems accelerate routing and forecasting, while network design, carrier negotiation, and exception handling still require people.
risks: Algorithms absorb manual routing.
Platform-based replacement
Sudden supply-chain disruptions
Performance pressure
Frequently changing rules

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, analysts still decide which networks deserve service guarantees, how to negotiate with carriers, and how to recover from disruptions. Delivery ultimately still requires people to think, negotiate, and adjust operations.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「算法 + 平台」——手工排线被系统吃，有设计力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「算法优化 + 平台」——路径与预测被系统提速，但网络设计、承运商谈判与异常处置仍要人。
risks: 算法吃手工排线
平台化替代
断链突发
指标压
规则多变

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪张网值得保时效、怎么和承运商谈、断链怎么救，最后还是分析师的脑去想、嘴去谈、手去调——交付这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Can qualify as a nurse and advance

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for Nursing Assistants is not AI, but exhaustion. Move toward certification, specialties, and eldercare management. The larger the shortage, the more these workers are needed.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main occupational risks are intensity and compensation. Long-term night shifts, heavy repositioning work, and infection exposure drive high burnout. Pay is generally low and advancement limited, but the shortage is enormous. Moving toward certified eldercare improves both stability and income.
risks: Burnout: night shifts and high-intensity work
Lower-back strain: frequent repositioning and transfers
Infection risk: contact with patients' bodily fluids
Low compensation: frontline nursing pay is limited
Emotional strain: exposure to illness and loss

page.contract_project_risk_block: Robots can deliver medication, but they cannot deliver the warmth of holding a hand. The most valuable part of care will always be human companionship.

responsibilities: Assist with eating, washing, and repositioning
Prevent pressure injuries and provide bed-unit care

career_risk_cards.callout: 护理助理最大的风险不是 AI，而是「透支」——往持证、专科和养老管理方向走，缺口越大，越是被需要的人。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要是「强度与待遇」：长期夜班、重体力翻身、感染风险，职业倦怠高发；同时薪资普遍偏低、晋升受限，但需求缺口巨大，往养老护理和持证方向走，稳定性和收入都能改善。
risks: 职业倦怠：夜班与高强度工作
腰肌劳损：频繁翻身搬运
感染风险：接触病患体液
待遇偏低：基层护理薪资不高
情感消耗：面对病痛与离别

page.contract_project_risk_block: 机器人送得了药，送不了「握住手」的温度——照护里最贵的那部分，永远是人的陪伴。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but performing mechanical exercise guidance without learning assessment. Assistants who assess, communicate, and adjust plans can withstand the spread of robots.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is the spread of rehabilitation robots and human-machine interaction devices. Exoskeletons and rehabilitation robots assist or replace some repetitive exercises, but patient communication, movement demonstration, and training adjustments still require people in the near term. Rehabilitation-care expansion supports a positive overall outlook.
risks: Rehabilitation robots and exoskeletons assist or replace some exercise guidance
Smart equipment pressures purely repetitive exercise-supervision roles
High physical demands and risk of back and neck strain
Low assistant pay, with certification required for advancement
Large differences in equipment and compensation among local rehabilitation institutions

page.contract_project_risk_block: Rehabilitation robots can practice gait with patients and exoskeletons can help them stand, but you are still needed to notice that someone is not themselves, is compensating during an exercise, or needs different encouragement. Rehabilitation helps people relearn life; machines provide strength, but not warmth.

responsibilities: Operate physical therapy equipment to deliver treatment
Record training progress and provide feedback
Maintain safety and disinfection in training areas
skills: Assistance with gait and joint assessment

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只做机械带练不学评估」——会评估、懂沟通、能调方案的助理，才扛得住机器人普及。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「康复机器人与人机交互设备」的普及：外骨骼、康复机器人正在辅助或替代部分重复训练环节，但患者沟通、动作示范和训练调整，短期内离不开人；岗位需求受康复医疗扩张带动，整体向好。
risks: 康复机器人与外骨骼辅助替代部分带练
纯重复训练岗受智能设备冲击
体力消耗大，腰颈劳损风险
助理岗收入偏低，靠考证晋升
基层康复机构设备与待遇差异大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 康复机器人能陪患者练步态、外骨骼能帮着站起来，但「他今天状态不对、动作做变形了、需要换个方式鼓励」——这些观察和分寸，还得靠你。康复是「陪人重新学会生活」的活，机器给得了力量，给不了温度。

responsibilities: 指导患者完成康复训练
操作理疗设备实施理疗
维护训练区安全与消毒

career_path_block.说明: Replaced fastest by AI and platforms
Strong strategic and negotiation skills, high value
Coordinate the full chain, advancement path

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but uncontrollable supply. You cannot control markets, but the company expects you to withstand them, which is precisely the purchasing manager's value.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI but supply-chain uncertainty. Sudden price increases, supplier failures, shortages, and quality incidents all become procurement's responsibility. AI can streamline processes, but managers always bear accountability.
risks: AI and e-procurement platforms compress order-tracking roles
Supply-chain events such as price increases, disruptions, and failures create heavy accountability
Performance and cost-target pressure
Frequent business entertainment and travel
High ethical requirements and firm corruption and compliance red lines

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can compare prices, forecast, and review contracts, but purchasing managers always own the decisions and responsibility for renewing suppliers, closing negotiations, and sustaining supply during disruptions.

responsibilities: Organize price comparisons, negotiations, and supplier management

career_path_block.说明: 被 AI 与平台替代最快

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「供应不可控」——你控制不了行情，但公司要求你扛得住，这正是采购经理存在的价值。
career_risk_cards.fact: 最大的风险不是 AI，而是「供应链的不可控」：突发涨价、供应商暴雷、断货和品质事故，责任都在采购头上；AI 能把流程做顺，但担责的永远是经理。
risks: AI 与电子采购平台压缩跟单型岗位
供应链事件（涨价、断供、暴雷）责任压力大
绩效与成本指标考核压力
商务应酬与出差频繁
职业操守要求高，腐败与合规风险红线

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能比价、能预测、能审合同，但「跟这家供应商续不续约、这轮谈判怎么收口、断供时怎么顶住」——这些决策和责任，永远是采购经理的。

responsibilities: 组织比价谈判与供应商管理
skills: 团队管理与跨部门协作

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for dyeing and finishing operators is not isolated AI replacement, but remaining at the lowest level during industry transformation. Advancing into processes and automation is essential to avoid being left behind.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is combined industrial relocation and automation. Low-end printing and dyeing is moving abroad while dye-vat automation accelerates. Operators who only press buttons and do not understand process principles will have progressively less room.
risks: Industrial relocation: Low-end printing and dyeing moves abroad and eliminates jobs
Automation replacement: Roles limited to starting machines are shrinking
Heavy physical demands: Heat, humidity, and shifts harm the body
Pollution and environmental pressure: Industry remediation affects employment
Color-matching pressure: Incorrect color forces rework of an entire batch

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate a formula but cannot calculate the workshop's human feel. The timing and visual judgment at a dye vat are skills machines cannot acquire quickly.

responsibilities: Prepare dyes and chemicals and operate equipment
Resolve color differences and equipment anomalies

career_risk_cards.callout: 染整操作员最大的风险不是 AI 单点替代，而是「产业转型中停留在最底层」——往工艺和自动化走，才不会被甩下车。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「产业转移 + 自动化」双重挤压：低端印染向海外转移，染缸自动化在提速，只会按按钮、不懂工艺原理的操作员，生存空间会越来越小。
risks: 产业转移：低端印染外移导致岗位流失
自动化替代：只会开机的操作员收缩
劳动强度大：高温高湿、倒班伤身体
污染与环保压力：行业整改影响就业
调色压力：颜色不对整批返工

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 算得出配方，算不出车间的「手感」——染缸前的火候和眼力，是机器短时间补不上的功夫。

responsibilities: 配制染化料并操作设备

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but limiting your craft to standard parts. Automatic sharpeners replace standard grinding, while people who understand CNC, master processes, and grind irregular tools become scarcer as automation spreads.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risk is narrow skills. CNC grinders and automatic sharpeners are replacing workers limited to ordinary standard tools. Dust, noise, and vision strain from prolonged focus on grinding wheels are also occupational costs.
risks: Automation impact: automatic grinders replace standard sharpening
Narrow skills: workers limited to standard tools face high risk
Occupational health: dust, noise, vision strain
Income ceiling: limited advancement in purely manual roles
Industry volatility: follows machining business cycles

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can calculate parameters, manage tool life, and automatically grind standard tools, but a grinder's hands and eyes are still needed for the intuitive adjustments on irregular tools and the final visual check of edge quality. Machines can grind to a standard; they cannot reproduce craftsmanship.

responsibilities: Inspect cutting edges and surface quality

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「手艺停在标准件」——自动刃磨机替代的是标准磨削，会数控、懂工艺、能磨异形刀具的人，反而是自动化越普及越稀缺。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「技能单一」——只会磨普通标准刀具的磨工，正被 CNC 磨床和自动刃磨机替代；粉尘、噪音和长期注视砂轮的视力损耗也是职业成本。
risks: 自动化冲击：标准刃磨被自动磨床替代
技能单一：只会磨标准刀具风险高
职业健康：粉尘、噪音、视力损耗
收入天花板：纯手工岗提升有限
产业波动：随机械加工景气度走

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能算参数、管寿命、自动磨标准刀，但异形刀具那几下「凭手感调整」和刃口质量的那一眼把关，还得磨工的手和眼睛来——锋利这件事，机器磨得出标准，磨不出手艺。

skills: 普通磨床与数控磨床操作

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but platforms plus automation. Routine delivery is being taken over, while professionals with diagnostic ability and strategic judgment become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to the role is not AI but platforms plus content automation. Microlearning, AI instructors, and learning systems are taking over standard delivery, and training is often viewed as a cost. Strategic organizational development, however, still requires human leadership.
risks: Platforms take over standard courses
Content is generated automatically
Training is viewed as a cost
Outcomes are difficult to quantify
Schedules courses without diagnosing needs

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent the system becomes, managers must still decide which capabilities to develop first, how to align them with the business, and how to calculate the results. They must think through the strategy, communicate it, and build the system. People cannot be fully removed from talent development.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「平台 + 自动化」——标准交付被接手，有诊断力和战略脑的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不是 AI，而是「平台 + 内容自动化」——微课、AI 讲师与学习系统吃掉标准交付，且培训常被视作成本；同时战略级组织发展仍要人经营。
risks: 平台吃标准课
内容自动生成
培训被视作成本
效果难量化
只排课不诊断

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪类能力先补、怎么和业务对齐、效果怎么算，最后还是经理的脑去想、嘴去说、手去搭——人才这头，人撤不干净。
